name: hnx_vms_bank-v1-COMMIT
purpose: HBM-NEXT P=4 VM bank, 2^19 words (A0+A1 data macros, 17-bit sector); hnx fork of vm_native_q0_faces_g313c

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hnx_vms_bank_q0_faces u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_next/vm/hnx_vms_bank_q0_faces.sv rtl/hbm_next/vm/ot_hnx_vms_bank_q0_core.sv rtl/hbm_next/vm/ot_hnx_vms_bank_q0_body.sv rtl/hbm_next/vm/ot_hnx_vms_ce_counter_pipe.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hnx_vms_bank/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hnx_vms_bank/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hnx_vms_bank --out {RUN}/record/views/hnx_vms_bank_q0_faces --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: HBM-NEXT-UNITS-VM (P=4 next die, not a release gate): hnx fork of the d4g SE/NE/SW/NW VM bank master vm_native_q0_faces_g313c (hfd_vms_bank_native_q0_faces, all 32 d4g banks). VM grows 2^18 -> 2^19 words: 4th SRAM u_a1 (A1 = quadrant rows 1024-2047) in the same abutted N-S stack (+90.624 um: outline 270 x 313.2 -> 270 x 403.92), direct clock entry clk_macro3 at its clk pin; check macro B carries the A1 field [167:112]; 3:1 capture mux; 17-bit sector (+1 bit on rq/wq/dq/kq/xq/xq2/eg/pq). Same edges (read n+6, +1 pin), same face clocks/pin registers. Pins: d4g plan with widened buses (N/S d4g slots; W/E re-spread at 7 M4 tracks on the taller faces), tools/hbm_next/hnx_vm_pins.py.
